description: This Java source file defines the LogFragment class which extends Android's Fragment. It manages a user interface component containing a custom LogView within a ScrollView, used for displaying log messages in an Android application. The class provides methods to initialize the views and manage text changes to keep the log scrolled to the bottom.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays a LogView inside a ScrollView, suitable for showing log messages and keeping the view scrolled to the bottom when new logs arrive.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures a ScrollView containing a LogView, sets layout parameters, padding, typeface, gravity, and text appearance.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the views using inflateViews(), sets a TextWatcher on mLogView to auto-scroll on text change, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the instance of LogView managed by this fragment.

search-terms: scroll to bottom on log update
